verdict.rationale: Docs describe a live_view_url/live preview that lets a human take over mid-run (e.g. for CAPTCHAs or 2FA), which is direct evidence of watch-live + human handoff, but this is framed around specific stuck-points (CAPTCHA, 2FA) rather than a general-purpose live session viewer/control UI for any stuck state, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the live control experience. missing for 10: first-party docs/demo of a general always-available live session viewer for arbitrary agent failures (not just CAPTCHA/2FA), independent or hands-on confirmation that mid-run human takeover actually works smoothly, and details on resuming agent control after human intervention beyond the 2FA example.
